be 动词 am / is / are · 易错辨析(第4轮): Use am/is/are to express identity and state: I use am; singular/he/she/it uses is; plural/you/we/they use are.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:The subject and the be verb must agree。

The first-person singular I always pairs with am|Singular nouns and he/she/it use is|Plural nouns and you/we/they use are|be + adjective expresses state|be + noun expresses identity|In the negative add not after be, in questions move be before the subject

column4: 考查The subject and the be verb must agree。此处应为 am。句意:我是一名新学生。
